verdict.rationale: Base44 documents connecting an app to GitHub for "version control, local development, and collaboration" (base44-docs-18, base44-docs-2). A community report on a since-fixed vulnerability shows apps have editor/collaborator roles (base44-comm-9), which implies multi-user editing. However, team collaboration happens mainly through external GitHub sync, and nothing describes a native shared team workspace. Missing for 10: first-party docs on shared team workspaces, inviting teammates and role or permission management, real-time co-editing in the app editor, and independent hands-on corroboration of team workflows.
